task.text:
[0] The ubiquitination of EPS-8 was blocked by generating lysine (K) to arginine (R) mutants. Ubiquitin-less mutations did not result in loss of EPS-8 function, as EPS-8(K524R/K583R/K621R) mutants did not exhibit embryonic lethality or developmental arrest. However, EPS-8(K524R/K583R/K621R) worms had upregulated EPS-8 protein levels at young adult stages, resulting in a short-lived phenotype. 100 μg ml−1 5-fluoro-2′deoxyuridine (FUdR) was added to prevent the development of progeny.

[2] Muscle-specific knockdown of eps-8 after development extends lifespan C. elegans. 100 μg ml−1 5-fluoro-2′deoxyuridine (FUdR) was added to prevent the development of progeny.

[3] Neuronal-specific knockdown of eps-8 after development extends lifespan C. elegans. 100 μg ml−1 5-fluoro-2′deoxyuridine (FUdR) was added to prevent the development of progeny.

[4] 100 μg ml−1 5-fluoro-2′deoxyuridine (FUdR) was added to prevent the development of progeny.

[5] 100 μg ml−1 5-fluoro-2′deoxyuridine (FUdR) was added to prevent the development of progeny.

[6] 100 μg ml−1 5-fluoro-2′deoxyuridine (FUdR) was added to prevent the development of progeny.

[7] Mice, overexpressing HER2 (ERBB2), started developing tumors earlier than control, had higher tumor burden, and died before one year of age. Age-associated changes of serum glucose, insulin, and IGF1 occurred in transgene mice earlier than in control.

[8] The rapamycin treatment of the cancer-prone HER2 -/- mice prevented age-related weight gain and increased mean and maximal lifespan. Rapamycin administration slowed down the tumor formation and decreased the number of tumors in mice.

[9] C57Bl/6-background mice with carboxy-terminal truncation of ERCC1 gene (lacking last 7 aminoacids) had a life span of up to 6 months.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
